observations.body: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

observations.body: The psalm recalls provocation, testing, and forty years of grief.

observations.body: Meribah and forty wilderness years become a warning addressed to present hearers.

payload.posture: Read Psalms 95:6–10 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
